<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def analyze(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    cell_rows=[12,18,24,30,36,42,48]; cell_cols=[11,17,23,29,35,41,47]
    n=[]; gf=[]; gh=[]
    for gr,rt in enumerate(cell_rows):
        for gc,ct in enumerate(cell_cols):
            chars=set()
            for dr in range(4):
                for dc in range(4):
                    chars.add(a[rt+dr][ct+dc])
            if 'N' in chars: n.append((gr,gc))
            if 'G' in chars: gf.append((gr,gc))
            if 'g' in chars: gh.append((gr,gc))
    return n,gf,gh
print("before:", analyze(current_frame))
# click the ghost/preview cell (1,3)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':30}])
print("after click(1,3):", analyze(current_frame))
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over']})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def analyze(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    cell_rows=[12,18,24,30,36,42,48]; cell_cols=[11,17,23,29,35,41,47]
    n=[]; gf=[]; gh=[]
    for gr,rt in enumerate(cell_rows):
        for gc,ct in enumerate(cell_cols):
            chars=set()
            for dr in range(4):
                for dc in range(4):
                    chars.add(a[rt+dr][ct+dc])
            if 'N' in chars: n.append((gr,gc))
            if 'G' in chars: gf.append((gr,gc))
            if 'g' in chars: gh.append((gr,gc))
    return n,gf,gh
